control_name: Reinsurance messaging conforms to ACORD GRLC
control_objective: Every reinsurance message exchanged with brokers, cedents, and reinsurers conforms to the ACORD Global Reinsurance and Large Commercial (GRLC) standard so that placements, bordereaux, and technical accounts process straight-through.
risk_addressed: Reinsurance messages that fail GRLC conformance are rejected by counterparty platforms, forcing manual rekeying, delaying technical accounting and claims advices, and increasing leakage on large-commercial and reinsurance treaties.

citation: ACORD Global Reinsurance and Large Commercial (GRLC)

required_data_elements.business_definition: A reinsurance or large-commercial message traversing the integration bus.
The GRLC schema version against which the message is validated, sourced from the schema registry.

method.summary: Validate a sample of reinsurance messages against the registered ACORD GRLC schemas and count conformance failures.
steps: Sample reinsurance and large-commercial messages from the integration bus over the period.
Resolve the applicable GRLC schema version from the schema registry for each message.
Validate each sampled message against its GRLC schema.
Count messages that fail GRLC conformance.
method.sampling_rule: Sample reinsurance messages across counterparties and message types over the assessment period.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any GRLC conformance failure on a reinsurance message is a conformance exception.

pass_criteria: No reinsurance messages fail GRLC conformance.
Sampled population validates against registered GRLC schemas.
fail_criteria: One or more reinsurance messages fail GRLC conformance.
exception_handling: Correct the message construction or mapping and re-validate before relying on the control.

assertions.description: No reinsurance messages fail GRLC conformance.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Continuous validation; evidence snapshot retained each assessment cycle.

actions_on_fail: Notify Integration Architect and Reinsurance Systems Analyst
